column1: # rubric.tsv — the sections of the otlp warrant set, one per test module,

column2: Spans: a Trace Span Round-Trips the Wire with Ids, Times and Status, and a Span a Receiver Would Misread Is Refused
Trace Command: One Span Is Posted to the Named Trace Store and Read Back Once, and Every Way It Can Fail Has Its Own Exit
Metric Command: One Sample Is Posted to the Named Metrics Store as the Kind Asked, and Every Way It Can Fail Has Its Own Exit
A Venv Whose Copy of mikemol.endpoints Is Not the Checkout's Says So on Stderr

The Metrics Reader: Series Print as JSON Lines, a Store That Answered Empty Is Exit Zero, an Unreachable Store Is Exit Three and Never an Empty Result, a Rejected Query Is Exit Four Naming the Error, and a Partial Range Is a Usage Error
